Texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information visit
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Reservation:Cannot: The reservation can only be confirmed when it is pending.
The reservation cannot be cancelled in its current state.
The reservation can only be completed when it is confirmed.
The reservation cannot be updated in its current state.
The reservation can only be deleted when it is pending.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Hall:UnderMaintena: The hall cannot be booked because it is under maintenance.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Hall:StatusCannotB: Hall status cannot be set to booked manually. It is derived from reservations.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Hall:StatusInvalid: Invalid hall status. Only available or maintenance are allowed.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Hall:CannotDeleteH: This hall cannot be deleted because it is linked to existing reservations. Please remove or reassign the related reservations before deleting this hall.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Customer:CannotDel: This customer cannot be deleted because they are linked to existing reservations. Please remove or reassign the related reservations before deleting this customer.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Service:CannotDele: This service cannot be deleted because it is used in existing reservations. Please remove it from related reservations before deleting this service.
